title: Clo User Summit: Bengaluru 2025
description:
What a day it was! 🎉

The CLO User Summit in Bengaluru brought together an incredible community including brands, manufacturers, vendors, sourcing teams, and educators - all coming together to explore the evolving world of 3D fashion.

With engaging talks, real-world insights and open conversations about innovation, adoption and what’s next, the event sparked ideas, connections and possibilities.

This was our first summit in the region, and it’s only the beginning. Here’s a glimpse into the energy and excitement of the day. ✨

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/ar...

---

transcript: It's super exciting to be here at the summit to be able to share some of our amazing student work but also to be able to interact with users from the industry. I have started exploring not just garments, packing boxes, footwears and which are all possible with clothing line. So I'm exploring and it's more fun. It's a very good seminar, we are meeting a lot of suppliers, a lot of brands and we are getting very fruitful insights here and it's been amazing to be a part of this. So today we have great experience with the industry leaders having a Closio Summit in Bangalore to understand what's the future in 3D. And we have been working with Cloteam since 2018 and it has been a great journey so far and we see quite a lot of future together. Closio Summit was actually very unique for the first time it happened in Bangalore and meeting like-minded people was actually delightful for us. Thank you. Very glad to be here at the user summit. It's a nice platform to meet everyone. Working with people from India. Bangladesh and Sri Lanka, it's very interesting. Thank you. So, thank you, Google Earth. Thank you to the team. And thanks to our users. Thank you. Thank you. Hooray!
markdown_content: ## Clo User Summit Bengaluru 2025: Industry Engagement and Insights This section covers the experiences and insights shared by participants at the Clo User Summit held in Bengaluru, focusing on industry collaboration, 3D technology applications, and the significance of the event for users and suppliers. Participants expressed excitement about engaging with industry leaders and users at the Clo User Summit, highlighting the opportunity to showcase innovative student work and explore diverse applications beyond traditional clothing. The event facilitated interaction with suppliers and brands, providing valuable insights into future trends in 3D technology within the fashion and apparel sectors. Since 2018, collaborations with the Cloteam have contributed to a growing journey of innovation in 3D design and garment visualization. The Bengaluru summit marked a unique milestone as the first event of its kind in the city, fostering connections among like-minded professionals from India, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka. Attendees appreciated the platform for its role in knowledge sharing and strengthening industry relationships. Overall, the Summit demonstrated the expanding possibilities of 3D technology in areas such as garments, packaging, and footwear, emphasizing its increasing relevance and the community’s enthusiasm for ongoing development.
